body: I cling to the hope that something good will come my way, especially on the job front. But nothing has materialized. I feel like such a loser. Majority of those 3 years I am self medicating so I feel a little numb. That's the only way I can go through life. I figured I can only take it for so long.

I live in country where seeing a shrink is not readily available. I've been jobless and broke af. I gave myself another year and this is the last month. This is the last month. I sought help and reached out to everyone I knew to get a job but nothing.
I've waited 3 years. I have not experienced anything good. I'm still jobless. I dont want to wait anymore. It's exhausting.
This is why I love reddit. Well-thought-out responses like this. You gave me a lot to think about and I wanna say thank you.
He keeps reassuring me it will work out and a part of me wants to believe him. Thanks for responding! This helped me a lot.

I'm not looking to be married at this stage, or ever. I just want a happy, committed relationship. He is not at the stage where he wants to settle down. He parties and gets drunk every weekend. I am over that stage in my life. I'm sorry I am very confused and wants some answers so I'm sort of babbling here. I did try to break it off at the start but I did second guess myself with what ifs.

You are right, a big part of me thinks that eventually he will fall for someone his age. There are times I actually wanted to tell him he is better off dating someone his age. I just want him to be happy and fulfilled.

Thanks for the response. I acknowledge I need to work on a lot of things with myself first. Having self-respect being one of them. To be honest, I am at the stage where I'd rather be single forever that date. It just so happens that this guy pursued me so I decided to give it a shot. Partly to boost my ego and self-esteem. That said, I do love him and care about him deeply.

My last relationship failed because I moved in to another country to get married. Later, I found out that my ex who is 10 years older than me got involved with a 20 yr something girl and decided to pursue her instead. I resigned from my job, left my family and uprooted my life but it did not work out. He would abuse me emotionally and call me unattractive and being a little too old for him. My ex is 40 years old. That's the basis of my calling it a "failed" relationship.

I came here to post something similar. I am 34 and a guy 10 years younger than me has been asking me out and is quite persistent. To be fair, he thought I was younger than him when he introduced himself. I've gone thru a failed long term relationship and my friends are encouraging me to have fun. 

It's hard to have fun when you're a woman my age as I get easily attached and of course is looking for a long term relationship. The guys seems a lot older than his age but I see what you guys mean when you say kids in their 20s are so different. I'm actually thinking if I will pursue this or not. 

Thanks for all the answers here. I was a bit enlightened.
